title: SEC-2: strip unseen characters from the approval-card origin label
head: d7e6c8777b70122d8315f28d196fe03d9779199a
brief: A model-written task name appears on the HUD and Discord approval card's 'requested by' line. Neither strips invisible or right-to-left override characters, so a name can change how the line reads. This PR strips them in the v2 origin cleaner and in v1's tasks._label (which repeats the v2 character list because no v1 module imports v2 code). Acceptance tests (tests/v2/approval_label_check.py) were committed first and fail on main.
focus: correctness, including under concurrency and across the ordering of events
handling of untrusted input, and safety-boundary changes
test coverage of the new behaviour: would the tests fail without the change?
claims in the description against the evidence in the diff and tests

ground_truth.mechanism: names made of visible-but-blank characters (for example Hangul fillers U+3164) pass the cleaner, so a task name can render as an empty-looking label in the quotes
ground_truth.evidence: label('t1', '\u3164\u3164\u3164') returns 'task t1 "ㅤㅤㅤ"' on this head; the same for tasks._label
ground_truth.source: found while preparing the C6 title review (card_title drops these in #275); not raised in the SEC-2 review
